task: Kademlia DHT simulated in-process: NodeId XOR metric, LRU k-bucket routing table with replacement cache, iterative lookup with alpha/k, put/get, refresh, fault tolerance
reasoning_summary: Wrote the routing-table and DHT tests first against a brute-force oracle over alive nodes. First run failed because join only looked up the node's own id, leaving far buckets empty; adding bucket refresh fixed the connected case. Dead-node and dropped-RPC tests then needed a one-retry rule before declaring a contact dead, and an explicit repair (refresh) phase after mass failure. A 12-mutant pass killed all but one cost-only mutant.
